title: Opposite party must respond to complaint
description: The opposite party must give their version of the case within the specified period

content.what: must give their version of the case
conditions: complaint admitted under sub-section (2) of section 36
complaint relates to goods in respect of which the procedure specified in sub-section (2) cannot be followed, or the complaint relates to any services
limitations: period of thirty days or extended period not exceeding fifteen days
